title: Performance comparison of three rapid screening methods for G6PD deficiency in newborns
core_idea: Compare the diagnostic performance of three point-of-care rapid screening tests (fluorescent spot test, G6PD rapid test kit, and SD Biosensor) for detecting G6PD deficiency in newborns, using spectrophotometry as the gold standard, by evaluating sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV and efficiency on blood samples from 70 newborns.
tldr: This study aims to evaluate and compare three point-of-care newborn G6PD screening methods against spectrophotometry using blood samples from 70 newborns to assess diagnostic accuracy metrics.
